description: This file defines a MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions within a request processing pipeline. It ensures that database transactions are properly begun, committed, or rolled back based on the success or failure of request handling.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior class for handling database transactions in MediatR request processing.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the request within a database transaction, committing if successful or rolling back if an exception occurs.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the request by starting a transaction, invoking the next handler, and committing or rolling back the transaction based on success or failure.
